seconds: Bending Spoons buys forgotten software and rebuilds it on one AI-native platform instead of flipping it like private equity. Buy to hold forever is the model.
Headcount reduction is a deliberate lever, not a side effect: fewer, denser teams running many products, with AI doing the rest.
The AI roll-up thesis now has its biggest live example. PE firms running roll-ups are a client segment for Alpha Infra.

standouts.title: This EU Firm Made Billions Buying Up Forgotten Tech
standouts.summary: Ed Elson sits down with Bending Spoons co-founder and CEO Luca Ferrari. Since its July Nasdaq listing, Bending Spoons has spent roughly 2.6 billion dollars buying forgotten software brands like AOL, Vimeo, Evernote, Eventbrite, and Airtable, plus a 1.35 billion dollar agreement for Miro. The interview covers the origin story, why it buys to hold forever instead of flipping like private equity, how it picks targets, and the role of headcount reduction and AI in rebuilding what it acquires.
args: Acquire to own, not to flip. Bending Spoons is roughly 25% private equity and 75% tech company: it buys 100% of each target off its balance sheet and holds it permanently, rebuilding every product on its own centralized platform instead of dressing it up for resale.

Deal selection is a volume game with one strict filter: can the business be rebuilt on the platform? The pipeline runs to about a thousand targets a year with only a handful of deals done, and price discipline decides the winners.

Lean teams plus AI is the operating model. Headcount reduction is deliberate, not incidental: fewer, more talented teams run many products, and Ferrari's recent interviews put AI-written code at 95% with productivity gains of two to three times.
Europe is a feature, not a handicap. A Milan headquarters with a global portfolio shows the forgotten-tech roll-up thesis travels well outside Silicon Valley.
standouts.why: This is the live, scaled example of the AI roll-up thesis from Friday's Startup Ideas episode: buy boring software, rebuild it with AI, keep it forever. Two Alpha Infra angles: PE firms running roll-ups are a client segment that needs exactly your rebuild-and-govern playbook, and the one-platform-many-products numbers are strong LinkedIn material for your CA and finance audience. Action: listen for how Ferrari selects targets and compare it against how you currently qualify consulting clients.
